title: Grilled Chicken Kebabs
description: A classic Middle Eastern dish featuring marinated chicken skewers grilled to perfection.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, and a pinch of salt.
2. Add the chicken cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat.
3. Thread the chicken onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
4. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
5. Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the chicken is cooked through.
6. Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
